That's exactly right. After I clicked "Import 4 bookmarks," my library filled out to eight, and the four new ones came in properly formed — each carrying the label from its old browser folder (Architecture, Reading, Travel and Research, Research), and crucially wearing their *original* saved dates: I can see one from 2022, one from 2023, one from this January, and the one that had no date just using today, exactly as the preview promised. So my history came across intact rather than being flattened to "today."

And the confirmation was honest about the whole job — "4 imported, 1 already here, 1 skipped" — so I know the duplicate was left alone and the unusable one was set aside rather than silently causing trouble. That's the smooth, trustworthy way to bring my old pile in. Import's just what I wanted. Now let's check the other direction — getting a proper file of my collection back out.
